The Problem We Solve

Most Buildings Run Five Security Systems That Never Talk to Each Other

Different installers, different apps, different passwords. When something happens, someone has to check each one by hand. We connect them so the systems do that work for you, and so our central station sees the whole picture when it matters.

What Integration Looks Like

When This Happens, the System Does This

When

A door is forced open

The system

Pops up the nearest camera, bookmarks the clip, and notifies our central station with video attached.

When

The fire alarm activates

The system

Releases egress doors and lanes, recalls elevators, keeps cameras recording, and dispatches from Boise.

When

The last person arms the building

The system

Switches readers to after-hours rules and turns on exterior camera analytics for the night.

When

Someone presses lockdown

The system

Locks every controlled door, alerts staff on their phones, and shows responders the live cameras.

When

Someone tailgates at a lane

The system

Raises a lane alarm and saves the clip showing who badged in and who followed.

When

You manage several locations

The system

Gives you one login and one alarm list for every site, with badges that work wherever you allow them.
